data.text: Verified against the docs before writing any config (criterion 5): Codex UserPromptSubmit carries prompt and session_id, plain stdout becomes developer context, matcher startup exists. The research had Cursor and Copilot wrong: neither reads plain stdout — Cursor sessionStart needs {"additional_context"} and Copilot {"additionalContext"} as JSON; so init installs the new kadence hook cursor-session / copilot-session (prime wrapped, {} on any failure, exit 0), and the installed shell command prints the same JSON with an install hint where kadence is missing. Written only where the agent is in use (.codex/, .cursor/, .github/hooks/ or .github/copilot-instructions.md) or named with --hooks-for (DEC-52). Not driven in a live agent: cursor-agent is installed here, but a live run sends the repository to Cursor under the owner's account — asked first. Hook command ~110 ms; core untouched. Full suite 1351 green.
